result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy the default.

Imagine a world where people genuinely try to understand each other before judging—where differences spark curiosity instead of fear, and where decisions are made with compassion for everyone they affect. So much conflict, cruelty, and inequality stem from a failure to see ourselves in others. Empathy wouldn’t solve everything overnight, but it would be the foundation for almost everything else: better leaders, kinder communities, fairer systems.

One change, but it would ripple everywhere.
